headline: Confidence Petroleum files AGM scrutinizer report and voting results
hook: AGM voting results now on record
summary: Confidence Petroleum India Limited has submitted its scrutinizer's report and voting results for the Annual General Meeting held on September 30, 2026. The filing complies with regulatory requirements for listed entities following shareholder meetings. For Indian retail investors, routine corporate governance filings like this carry no direct financial impact on stock valuation.
why_it_matters: Routine compliance filing with no impact on your portfolio.
